# Uppstuds för mjukvara – förvaltaren: ”Räkna inte ut dem”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This August 2026 episode of Börslunch with Handelsbanken fund manager Christian Brunlid centers on a rebound in Nordic software names (Addnode, Lime, Vitec) helped by strong US peers like Salesforce and Workday, alongside a broader Swedish macro recovery signalled by better-than-expected GDP. The discussion covers rehabilitation candidates (Kinnevik, Intrum), skepticism toward hype-driven Sivers Semiconductors, and transformational risk in Boliden's Latin American acquisition, while highlighting favoured smaller names like Smart Eye and a recently listed sports company.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ADDT-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Software rebound; gaining momentum after being written off in March.

#### Reasoning

Host and guest agree the software names left for dead in March have rerated, with Addnode getting 'air under its wings'. Sector supported by strong US peers (Salesforce, Workday) and AI theme. Guest explicitly says not to count them out, though upside may need another upgrade cycle.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-driven software rerating reverses
- if organic growth disappoints in next report

> *"Udnode börjar få lite luft under vingarna. Vi ska nog inte räkna ut dem i alla fall."*

---

### 🟡 LIME — Lime | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Software name performing well since summer amid sector rebound.

#### Reasoning

Guest notes Lime and Vitec have both performed well since summer as part of the software recovery, supported by positive read-across from US software peers and the AI theme dominating global markets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if software sector momentum fades
- if valuation outruns fundamentals

> *"Både Vitec och Lime har gått bra sen i somras."*

---

### 🟡 VIT-B — Vitec | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Software name performing well since summer amid sector rebound.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Lime as software names that have rebounded strongly since summer; sector tailwind from US software strength and AI narrative supports continued holding, though rapid further upside not expected without new catalysts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if software sector momentum fades
- if growth decelerates

> *"Både Vitec och Lime har gått bra sen i somras."*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

New CEO, conservative Q2 NAV marks leave upside, high discount likely to narrow.

#### Reasoning

Guest sees a turnaround setup: portfolio once feared doomed, new CEO settling in, Q2 valuation uplift modest vs peers implying further NAV gains in coming reports. He is fairly convinced the very high discount will fall as confidence returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new CEO fails to build confidence
- if portfolio NAV marks are cut
- if management instability continues

> *"Plus att öka förtroendet så kommer den här rabatten som är väldigt hög att sjunka är jag ganska övertygad om."*

---

### 🟠 INTRUM — Intrum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

High-debt turnaround; rights issue improves financing, could be interesting in ~3 years.

#### Reasoning

Difficult, highly leveraged case. July rights issue not yet visible in numbers; refinancing lowers debt and rate costs, improving cash flow to buy portfolios. If financial targets are met it could be very interesting in three years, with big leverage upside, but timing of market re-rating is uncertain. Fund holds only a tiny 'keyhole' position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if servicing/collection growth stalls
- if refinancing fails to lower rate costs
- if financial targets are missed

> *"Om de når sina finansiella mål och allt rullar på som de tänkt sig så kan det vara väldigt intressant om tre år."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Vague 'opportunity pipeline' metric, scripted call, hype without revenue; Fingerprint parallel.

#### Reasoning

Guest Söderfjäll draws Fingerprint parallel - hype, design wins, no revenue. Company highlights a questionable 'opportunity pipeline', ran a seemingly pre-recorded call skipping critical questions, keeps pushing out its hockey-stick. He'd rather miss early gains than risk losing 99%. Zombie-company risk despite ~10bn market cap; capital raised buys time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if actual revenue, cash flow and earnings materialise
- if pipeline converts to real orders
- if communication becomes transparent

> *"Jag skulle inte kunna tänka mig att sätta pengar i det här."*

---

### ⛔ TOBII — Tobii | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Poor report, little cash left, wrong strategic path chosen.

#### Reasoning

Eye-tracking firm has had a long run of poor reports; latest not fun reading and cash reserves are low. Guest says they chose the wrong path. On the day's loser list, signalling continued weakness and balance-sheet risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash position stabilises
- if a strategic pivot gains traction
- if a major customer win lands

> *"det har inte varit någon kul läsning på länge i det där bolaget tyvärr... de har valt lite fel spår"*

---

### 🟠 BOOZT — Boozt | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Falls after a large share placing; on the loser list.

#### Reasoning

Only mentioned as backing off after the prior day's large placing, appearing on the day's loser list. Technical/supply pressure noted rather than a fundamental thesis, so a cautious watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if placing overhang clears
- if next report shows growth

> *"följt av Boozt som backar efter gårdagens stora placing"*

---

### 🟠 BACTI-B — Bactiguard | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Top winner after EQT veteran Thomas von Koch sharply increased his stake.

#### Reasoning

Highlighted as the day's biggest gainer after well-known EQT figure Thomas von Koch materially increased his holding, an insider/ownership signal of confidence, though no fundamental thesis was elaborated.

#### Sell Triggers

- if von Koch reverses buying
- if fundamentals disappoint

> *"allt skuggas av Bactiguard, som är högst upp på vinnarlotten efter att EQT-långvägaren Thomas von Koch ökat sitt innehav rejält"*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

CEO Håkan likely to become chairman; market and guest like him, seen fixing Volvo.

#### Reasoning

Guest expects CEO Håkan (nearing end of two-year mandate) to move to chairman, which he views positively; market likes him and he's put Volvo on the right track even if not yet visible in numbers. Chairman engagement improves vs the Geely-linked incumbent. Positive governance read.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the chairman transition doesn't happen
- if operational numbers keep lagging
- if Geely ownership friction worsens

> *"Marknaden gillar honom, jag gillar honom... Det kommer nog bli klart bättre framöver för dem"*

---

### 🟢 SEYE — Smart Eye | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Punished on report but undeserved; 128% organic growth, regulatory tailwinds, new orders.

#### Reasoning

Guest thinks the sell-off was largely due to an analyst over-raising forecasts (to ~200%) after peer Seeing Machines' report; actual 128% organic growth is not bad. Regulatory tailwinds, more car models rolling out, and fresh orders (15m yesterday) support the thesis; OPEX rise is investment in added functionality. Automaker customers pay slowly, pressuring cash flow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth decelerates sharply
- if automaker payment delays worsen cash flow
- if OPEX rises without order intake

> *"Sen kom bolaget in på 128 procent och det är inte så dåligt egentligen... Trenderna är verkligen med dem."*

---

### 🟡 BOLI — Boliden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Latin American zinc mine acquisition adds risk and dilutes multiple ~15%; heavy domestic capex already.

#### Reasoning

Guest shares Söderfjäll's skepticism: blended multiple drops ~15% and there was a reason Nexa was cheap; large far-away transformational M&A on a new continent carries integration risk with many failed Swedish precedents. Boliden already has heavy domestic capex (Garpenberg, Laver). New 7% owner could add discipline. Fund has reduced its holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if integration of Nexa runs into trouble
- if domestic capex strains cash flow
- if zinc/metal prices fall

> *"jag är också lite skeptisk när man gör så här stora förvärv på en annan kontinent som man inte varit på tidigare"*

---

### 🟢 MYCR — Mycronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Capital markets day; very fine company, won new order, likely to raise targets after hitting old ones fast.

#### Reasoning

Guest calls it a very fine company that won another order and holds its capital markets day. His 'gut analysis' is it would not be unreasonable to raise targets since it has reached its old targets quite quickly, given how well business has gone.

#### Sell Triggers

- if targets are not raised at the CMD
- if order intake slows
- if execution disappoints

> *"Det vore inte orimligt att skruva upp målen lite grann eftersom jag tror att man har nått sina gamla mål ganska snabbt."*

---

### 🟠 THULE — Thule | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Could benefit from consumer/car-sales recovery but has been sluggish; many markets must improve.

#### Reasoning

Discussed as a possible beneficiary of the Swedish consumer/durables recovery, tied to rising car sales (roof racks). But guest notes it's been sluggish and depends heavily on non-Swedish markets, urging cherry-picking - a tentative watch rather than conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if car-sales recovery stalls
- if key export markets weaken
- if consumer durables demand stays soft

> *"Det har varit lite segt för dem tycker jag. Man får vara lite cherry picking i Sverige också"*

---
